BNPS.co.uk (01202 558833).Pic: Phil Yeomans/BNPS..Queing up at feeding time........Shropshire farmer Dinah Thompson(55) was amazed when her prize ewe 'Mrs Holmes' delivered a quintuplet of tiny lambs this week at her farm near Bewdley...The odds on quintuplets are one in a million, so Dinah could not believe her eyes when four year old Mrs Holmes produced the instant flock. 'I was expecting triplets so after the third popped out I went off for a cup of coffee, when I returned i was amazed to find another two had emerged'..The three girls and two boys are now being bottle fed every four hours as the struggling mum only has two teats to feed her hungry little flock with.

Torches blaze behind him. He spills wine casually, the same way he spills blood. He wears beautiful clothing and ermine furs, with a crown of rubies on his head. He holds a scepter in his other hand.
